architecture: A monolithic run loop coordinates planning, execution, and recovery.
Agent memory is retrieved only after failures.
Verification occurs only after a full implementation attempt.
Parallel workers share no explicit capability contract.
Operators discover stalled work from end-of-run logs.
Work is selected greedily without value-of-information estimates.
Recovery retries the same failed approach with larger timeouts.
Users must translate goals into low-level implementation steps.
